Initial release of EchoAgent, a minimal OpenClaw-compatible reference agent.

- Accepts text input and processes it deterministically.
- Returns output via a simple interface.
- Designed for use and chaining within OpenClaw agent workflows.
- Serves as a reference for building and publishing OpenClaw skills.
